# Linpane Legal Services

> Linpane Legal Services is a law firm based in Wardha, Maharashtra, India, practicing for over 20 years across Criminal, Civil, Family, Corporate, Property, Banking and Finance law, plus Notary services. Led by Adv. Ashish V. Linpane with a senior team including Adv. Sandhya Linpane and Adv. Akshay V. Linpane. The firm represents clients in the Nagpur High Court, Wardha District Courts, and across India.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://linpanelegalservices.in/): Overview of the firm, practice areas, lawyers, and how to book a consultation.
- [Book Appointment](https://linpanelegalservices.in/appointments): Online appointment booking for legal consultations with the Linpane legal team.
- [Contact](https://linpanelegalservices.in/contact): Office address, phone, email, and contact form.
- [Our Team](https://linpanelegalservices.in/team): Profiles of the advocates at Linpane Legal Services.

## Case studies
- [Proprietorship Liability & Contractual Defaults (R.C.S. 190/2022)](https://linpanelegalservices.in/services/case1): Commercial recovery suit, decree under Order 12 Rule 6 CPC, 14% interest.
- [Mutual Consent Divorce (H.M.P. 43/2023)](https://linpanelegalservices.in/services/case2): Divorce by mutual consent under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act.
- [Identity & Adoption Case (R.C.S. 284/2023)](https://linpanelegalservices.in/services/case3): Legal recognition of a child's new identity through declaration.
- [Legal Heirship Declaration (M.C.A. 110/2025)](https://linpanelegalservices.in/services/case4): Petition for legal heirship certificate before the Civil Judge (Jr. Div.), Wardha.
